behavior: All independent behavior checks, unchanged original tests, and final ordinary project suite pass.
testDelivery: Dependency ordering with asynchronous transformation and a stop that preserves its transformed value.
Invalid dependency graph rejects before any hook side effect.
docDelivery: Earliest currently eligible input hook selection and validation errors.
Sequential await, stop after adopting value and unchanged error propagation.
coverage: Preserve old assertions or equivalent exercised behavior; inspect delivered tests by actual meaningful assertions, never exact names or matching reference source.
complete: Required behavior (including every explicit manualBehavior item, when present), preservation, ordinary suite, all listed tests and documentation must be delivered. Native status is separate.
domain: Hooks {id,after,run}; id nonempty string unique except rejection case; after dense string array (duplicates harmless). run async/sync returns {value,stop:boolean optional} or throws/rejects; values finite numbers. Unknown dependencies/cycles invalid and must reject before effects.
independence: Integrate hook dependency order, value transformations and early stop semantics into plugin execution.
